scope: Continue the task plan after per-task infrastructure retry exhaustion
verified_behavior: Retryable task errors exhaust three task attempts, retain an error outcome and continue with the next method_x_question
A plan in which every task fails still visits all tasks with independent retry budgets
Real RerankerClient and HTTP retry/bisection code with a mocked HTTP opener reaches singleton HTTP 500 three times and then executes later methods and questions
Skip events include failed task, attempts, error, next task and per-attempt skip count in main, events and stop logs
Failed tasks remain in the frozen accuracy denominator and never produce fabricated scores or predictions
Resume retries failed tasks and preserves successful outcomes and append-only failure history
Worker and CLI return zero for completed_with_failures, and the background monitor reports completed while completion artifacts retain failure status and counts
Explicitly non-retryable task errors are skipped after one attempt
Startup service probe and operator interruption handling retain their existing stop behavior
deployment_note: An old run has a different source identity. Preserve existing credentials, venv and outputs; launch the upgraded source under new state/output roots. The historical validation_report.json describes the previous release.
